description: Google Play In-App Purchase (IAP) configuration for 28 core apps

googlePlayConsoleSetup.instruction: 1. Go to Google Play Console > Your app > Monetize > In-app products
googlePlayConsoleSetup.instruction2: 2. Create product IDs matching SKU names (e.g., app.premium.monthly)
googlePlayConsoleSetup.instruction3: 3. Set pricing using Pricing templates based on regions above
googlePlayConsoleSetup.instruction5: 5. Integrate Google Play Billing Library v7+ in mobile build
